# Third-party assets

Fonts bundled for the chat font setting. The files are in `core/designsystem/src/main/res/font`; their licences are in `fonts/`.

| Asset | Licence | Source |
|---|---|---|
| Atkinson Hyperlegible | SIL Open Font License 1.1 (`fonts/AtkinsonHyperlegible-OFL.txt`) | Braille Institute of America, via github.com/google/fonts |
| OpenDyslexic | SIL Open Font License 1.1 (`fonts/OpenDyslexic-OFL.txt`) | github.com/antijingoist/opendyslexic |
